purpose: Determine whether a properly task-qualified Chinese MLM supplies useful candidate evidence. No mobile runtime deployment in this experiment.

qualificationOrder.reason: Small explicitly Apache-2.0 Chinese model with published distillation training code; must verify its released MLM head before accuracy replay.
Fallback teacher only if MiniRBT fails task qualification, never selected by comparing Sense dev accuracy. Official Chinese BERT card explicitly supports MLM and Apache-2.0.

required: Exact pinned model and file digests
Actual MLM transform and bias tensors present
Canonical local loading with no missing/mismatched weights
At least 6 of 8 predeclared elementary fill-mask targets in top 5

selection: Evaluate only the first qualified model. Stop if both fail. No model switching after viewing its Sense dev results.
scoring: Exactly E37 target-blind PLL: first 8 same-length Han slots, 2..24 characters, fixed 0..2 left context characters, sum masked-character log probabilities, no interpolation, unknown-character whole-row pass-through, stable ties and unchanged candidate membership.
runtime: CPU float32 eager, 2 intraop threads, 1 interop thread, mask microbatch 32, no cross-query score cache.

development.baseline: E36 production outputs, verified against current source, assets and input hashes before reuse.
development.gate: Each domain top1/top5 nondecreasing, recall255 unchanged and character errors nonincreasing; combined top1 strictly increases. Known development states, not new blind data.

diagnosticOnly: E28 six known lei states do not control promotion.
stopRule: If qualified-model development fails, preserve full outputs and do not tune pool/weights or try another model this stage. If it passes, proceed with separate regression and lightweight deployment/distillation study; no direct default adoption.
release: Keep rc.4 and production model/assets unchanged. No user input sent to external inference services.
